thread:
Marta: Heads-up: tight change window tonight 21:15-21:45 UTC for release/2024.10. Scope: split shared state for tenant-y, small route table cleanup, and create cross-account assume-role for billing. Also enabling stricter tagging enforcement.
Marta: Who can own the apply + a 1-paragraph release note? No auto-approve for the second region.
Colin: I can run the applies. I'll be oncall and remote. What's the rollback policy?
Priya: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure; sustained LB 5xx > 5/min for 6m; or API error rate +3% for 10m. Manual abort if p95 increases > 150ms for 5m. If a provider/plugin mismatch occurs, fallback plan is to pin to last-known-good provider and reinit.
devops-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/tenant-y-split  follow section "Rollback / provider mismatch" for steps.
deploybot: preflight checks queued...
deploybot: preflight OK  terraform plan succeeded for targeted modules. Provider pin: aws v4.90.0 (lock sha: aa1bb2).
Colin: Plan cmds I'll run locally:
```
cd infra/tenants/tenant-y
terraform workspace select prod || terraform workspace new prod
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=prod.backend
terraform plan -out=plan.prod -var-file=tenant-y.prod.tfvars
```
Priya: Stagger: apply us-east-1 first -> run smoke checks and canary traffic verification -> if green, prepare eu-central plan and hold for manual approval.
Colin: Noted. I'll snapshot remote state to s3://infra-snaps/tenant-y/$(date +%s).tfstate before any apply and tag with the PR sha.
deploybot: locking remote state for apply...
deploybot: apply started by Colin at 1738887850 (us-east-1)
Colin: Seeing an expected plan: split state objects, add assume-role redwood-billing-role, and tag enforcement changes. Proceeding.
deploybot: apply completed (us-east-1) at 1738887920  success
Colin: Running smoke checks: `./scripts/smoke-tenant-y.sh us-east-1`
Priya: Smoke OK  health 5/5, assume-role test passes, no route flaps. Preparing eu-central plan.
Colin: Prepping eu-central plan now. Will not auto-approve.
deploybot: preflight for eu-central queued...
deploybot: preflight failed at 1738887980  error: provider plugin version mismatch (lockfile requests aws v4.90.0, existing plugin on host v4.92.0).
Priya: Hmm. That mismatch can block the apply. Options: 1) align CI/runner to v4.90.0, 2) update lockfile to v4.92.0 if compatible, or 3) pin to last-known-good (v4.90.0) and reinit. We should prefer pin -> reinit to avoid unexpected provider changes.
Colin: I'll try reinit with explicit provider version and re-run plan. Command I'll run:
```
terraform init -reconfigure -get-plugins -upgrade=false
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -add-provider=registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws@4.90.0
```
devops-bot: Reminder: do not force-unlock state. If provider override needed, update lockfile and commit it to infra repo per runbook.
Colin: Re-ran init with provider lock and requeued plan.
deploybot: preflight OK at 1738888005  plan ready.
Colin: Approving eu-central apply now (manual approval). Starting at 1738888010.
deploybot: apply started by Colin (eu-central) at 1738888011
deploybot: apply failed at 1738888020  error: iam_policy mismatch - remote policy has an extra statement (out-of-band update detected).
Priya: That looks like an external change from billing automation. DO NOT force-apply. Follow runbook: fetch live policy, stash, and ask billing to revert if transient. If not revertable, we may need to update terraform to match remote and do a controlled deploy.
Colin: Pulled live policy via `aws iam get-policy-version` and uploaded to s3://infra-snaps/tenant-y/policy-drift-1738888022.json. Pinged billing owners.
billing-owner-bot: Notified billing automation team of detected policy diff (ticket #INC-9421).
Priya: Billing team says they made a short-term emergency change and will revert in ~3m. Hold applies.
deploybot: re-run preflight after remote change.
deploybot: preflight OK at 1738888028  plan ready.
Colin: Re-running eu-central apply now.
deploybot: apply started by Colin (eu-central) at 1738888030
deploybot: apply completed (eu-central) at 1738888035  success
Colin: All applies done. Uploading final state snapshot and committing provider lockfile change to infra repo with context.
release-notes-bot: Draft released: "Infra: tenant-y state split + billing assume-role; route cleanup and tag enforcement. Change window 21:15 UTC. Note: transient IAM policy drift handled without rollback."
Marta: Thanks everyone. I'll post the short summary to #releases and update Confluence with the state split steps + provider pin notes. Closing change window. :thumbsup:
